title: GTA 6 - Everything We Know Before November 19 | Release Date, Map, Characters, Price
description: Everything confirmed about Grand Theft Auto VI before launch: the November 19, 2026 release date, platforms, pre-load, Lucia and Jason, the state of Leonida and its six regions, the record-breaking trailers, the delays, PC status, price and the Game Informer cover story.

sections.heading: GTA 6 is almost here
sections.script: Grand Theft Auto six is the most anticipated game in the world, and it is finally close. In this video we go through everything Rockstar has actually confirmed, from the release date and platforms, to the characters, the map, the trailers, the price, and what we know about a PC version. No rumours, no leaks, just confirmed facts. Let's get into it.

sections.heading: Release date and platforms
sections.script: GTA six launches on November nineteenth, twenty twenty six. At launch it is coming to PlayStation five and Xbox Series X and S. Pre-loading opens on November twelfth, one week before release, so you can download the game early and start playing the moment it unlocks. As of now, Rockstar has not announced any new delay.

sections.heading: Lucia and Jason
sections.script: This time there are two lead characters, and they are a couple: Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval. Lucia learned to fight from her father, and fighting for her family landed her in the Leonida Penitentiary. Jason grew up around grifters and crooks, joined the Army, and now lives in the Leonida Keys. Lucia is being described as the first female lead protagonist in the series.

sections.heading: Welcome to Leonida
sections.script: The game is set in the state of Leonida, Rockstar's take on Florida. Six regions have been shown so far: Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, and Mount Kalaga National Park. The Leonida Keys are a chain of islands linked by long bridges, and Grassrivers is a huge wetland of swamps and rivers. One important note: Rockstar has not released an official full map yet, so every full map you see online is fan made.

sections.heading: Vice City returns
sections.script: At the heart of Leonida is Vice City. It first appeared back in two thousand two in GTA Vice City, a neon city inspired by Miami and set in the nineteen eighties. Now it returns as a modern city. According to Game Informer's cover story, the game also features stormy Florida-style weather and a huge variety of wildlife on land, in the air and in the water.

sections.heading: The supporting cast
sections.script: Rockstar has also introduced several supporting characters. Boobie Ike is a Vice City legend who turned his street past into a business empire, including real estate and a recording studio. Cal Hampton is a conspiracy-loving friend who listens in on Coast Guard radio. Raul Bautista is an experienced bank robber. And there are also Dre'Quan Priest, the Real Dimez duo, and Brian Heder.

sections.heading: Record-breaking trailers
sections.script: The trailers have broken the internet. The first trailer arrived in December twenty twenty three and pulled in more than ninety three million YouTube views in twenty four hours, a record for a non-music video. The second trailer, in May twenty twenty five, reached four hundred and seventy five million views across all platforms in its first twenty four hours.

sections.heading: The road to launch: delays
sections.script: GTA six took a while to get here. Rockstar first said fall twenty twenty five. The game was then moved to May twenty sixth, twenty twenty six. And after one more delay, it now launches on November nineteenth, twenty twenty six. Rockstar has said it does not want to compromise on detail or scale.

sections.heading: Is GTA 6 coming to PC?
sections.script: The biggest question from PC players. The honest answer is that Rockstar has not announced a PC version yet. Launch is on PlayStation five and Xbox Series X and S only. For context, GTA five reached PC about a year and a half after its console launch, and Red Dead Redemption two about a year after. Any PC release date you see online right now is just a rumour.

sections.heading: Price and editions
sections.script: Pricing is confirmed. The Standard Edition costs seventy nine ninety nine, and that is the complete game, with no part of the story locked away. The Ultimate Edition costs ninety nine ninety nine and adds extra vehicles, weapons and clothing. Pre-orders opened on June twenty fifth, twenty twenty six.

sections.heading: Final thoughts
sections.script: So that is everything we know for sure. November nineteenth, PlayStation five and Xbox Series X and S, Lucia and Jason, Vice City and the state of Leonida. Are you buying it on day one, or waiting for a PC version? Tell me in the comments, and subscribe for more gaming news.
